svg.aria-label: Three defined teaching calculations. Gradient delay is 0.75 mL / 0.50 mL/min=1.5 min; spike recovery is modeled at 85%; a 10 mL release vessel is sampled by 1 mL withdrawals with analyte-free replacement, giving 87 micrograms cumulative release before the third withdrawal.
